title: 设计模式改名：标签是内联多语言映射时，用源语言改名会把整个映射替换成一个字符串，其他语言的译文丢失
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7123598133, item 2). Source: seat 3's ux-A dev on #36504 (PR #36858). It existed before that PR.

## What happens

A label can be authored as an inline locale map, for example `{ en: 'Orders', 'zh-CN': '订单' }`. When a builder renames such an item in design mode in the source language, the save writes the new text as a plain string over the whole map, and every other locale's value is lost from the stored metadata.

reach: reported by the dev, not measured in a browser. It reaches builders renaming in the source language an item whose label is an inline locale map, which is uncommon. Packages usually keep translations in locale packs.

## Expected

A source-language rename over an inline locale map replaces only the source-language entry and keeps the other locales' values.

## Acceptance

- The design-mode rename write path (menus and record tabs) updates only the source-language entry of an inline locale-map label.
- A test renames such a label in the source language and reads back every other locale's value unchanged.

Dedupe: open issues for a rename over an inline locale-map label return none. #36504 is the related parent.
